notes: README showcase images (pnpm showcase → docs/images/, tools/capture/showcase.ts). Sources: `review` = the V1 review stills (renders/qa/20261003-230100, set s4-review, final 1920×1080 spp 12, KEEP); `hero` = renders/shots/20261003-231307 (KEEP): pano-golden-sw (data/qa/shots.d/showcase.json, final 3072×1280 spp 16) and black-gate-wide (final 1920×1080 spp 12, the S4.5 reframe; black-gate-close shows the far plume as a blob) and weathertop-close (final 1920×1080 spp 12, the film-placeholder banner: Weathertop at dusk, on Frodo's road). Tiles follow the film: the prologue (Erebor, Lake-town), then Frodo's road from the Shire to Mount Doom. Every shipped image is a render of this project (no reference / film imagery); titles use the OFL Cinzel / Cormorant Garamond fonts (public/fonts). Kinds: still {src, w, h, crop?}, pair {pair: [day, night], h, seam}, social {social: true, 1280×640, < 1 MB}, banner {banner: true, darken, title}. Encode: pnpm showcase --dry (sizes), pnpm showcase (writes docs/images/ + manifest.json), pnpm showcase --snippet (README HTML).
